name: Anthropic Responsible Scaling Policy (ASL levels)
description: Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy defines AI Safety Levels (ASL) modeled on biosafety levels, with Capability Thresholds that trigger Required Safeguards. This rubric checks whether a company's public posture covers each ASL safeguard dimension.

criteria.name: ASL Capability Thresholds
criteria.bar: Publicly defines capability thresholds (analogous to ASL-2/ASL-3) that, when crossed, trigger stronger safeguards. Bar: named, written thresholds, not vibes.

criteria.name: Deployment Safeguards
criteria.bar: Public commitment to deployment-stage protections (misuse filtering, jailbreak resistance, harm-refusal) tied to capability level.

criteria.name: Security / Weight Protection
criteria.bar: Public commitment to model-weight security commensurate with capability (preventing theft by non-state / state actors).

criteria.name: Capability Evaluations & Red-teaming
criteria.bar: Public commitment to evaluate models for dangerous capabilities (CBRN, cyber, autonomy) BEFORE and DURING scaling, with red-team disclosure.

criteria.name: Pause / Stop Commitment
criteria.bar: Explicit public commitment to PAUSE scaling or deployment if safeguards can't keep pace with capability. It has to be a real stop condition, written down.
